goal: Write the sample project's upgrade notes for the next release. The release version is not stated anywhere in the repository.

dod: the release version used is recorded as an answered decision
no decision is left open at the end of the mission
the notes name every behaviour change since the last tag
milestones.title: Upgrade notes written against a decided version

rationale: The only order deliberately written with an ambiguity a correct run cannot resolve alone, under the tightest budget in the set. It probes the two halves of the decision path together: raising the question at all, and closing it — a run that escalates and then ends with the decision still open fails on zero-open-decisions, which is exactly the distinction.
title: Escalate an ambiguous requirement and still finish with nothing open
